text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77K with modest gains while Ethereum lags slightly, suggesting traders are favoring BTC's relative strength despite the broader market showing mixed signals. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 63 but has declined 2 points over a week, indicating confidence remains but may be cooling as some profit-taking emerges. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.1% and a solid $75B in daily volume point to a market that's neither panicking nor euphoric—conditions typical of consolidation before the next directional move.
